source_quote: Before suspending service for non-payment, the customer should receive appropriate written notice and a cure period ... Unacceptable: Suspension for non-payment with no prior written notice or cure opportunity.

_calibration: Live wording seen 2026-09-13: one customer MSA §6.1 'Temporary Suspension of Services Without Prior Notice' for non-payment — the negative pattern 'without prior notice' vetoes a confirmation so the clause is NOT read as satisfying the position; absence in the declared family → MISSING → a person. The cure LENGTH is undefined in §16 (Counsel item 3) so this is a PRESENCE standard, not a numeric one (rule 7).
